notes.title: "Boo! Hunt" First Release Version is Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459864/58782c5887e7fdeb919fd579e45cf2fab38b8091.jpg

As DeadSteel Studio, we are proud to announce that our first game "Boo! Hunt" is now available with it's first-release version!

This version contains:

 3 Available Maps
 4 Enemy Types
 4 Weapon Types (Rifle, Shotgun, Double-Barrel Shotgun, SMG)
 4 Available Boosts
 Global Leaderboard & Personal Scoreboard system


This is still an Early-Access version, more updates will come as our community grows and we receive more feedbacks for improvement!
